Acyuta Prekṣa
------------------------------------------
It is often seen that some persons become known to history because of their association with the more brilliant one who makes history. Whether the former, though deserving better recognition, are overshadowed by the latter, or, become known only because of their association with the latter who are head and shoulders above them, is a matter of opinion. अच्युत प्रेक्ष, who gave सṁन्यास to मध्वाचार्य belongs to this group. Not much is known of him. As per the scanty information available in the work Maṇimañjarī of Nārāyaṇācārya (14th cent. A.D.), he was the head of the ‘Bhaṇḍāra-keri मठ.’ His preceptor belonged to ‘Ānanda-bāla मठ’ and hailed from Nandigrāma. Since there are several Nandigrāmas in the country, it is difficult to decide which one it was. अच्युत प्रेक्ष was an advaitin and belonged to the भागवत school. It was he who administered the monastic vows and gave the new names Pūrṇa-prajña, Ānandatīrtha and others to मध्वाचार्य. He had to accept defeat from his own disciple while teaching him. In course of time, he was himself converted into a dvaitin.
See also MADHVĀCĀRYA.
